Eight Conservatives Join CentreBC Party; New Leader Appointed

Eight former Conservative members have joined the CentreBC party. Peter Milobar has been appointed as the new leader of CentreBC. The Toronto Star reported that this move has caused "chaos" within the Conservative party. The report also indicated that there was no decision made regarding an early vote. The specific reasons for the former Conservatives joining CentreBC or the implications for the party's leadership were not detailed in the provided coverage.
